{{Quote|Jai Maruk mentioned to me a lady he saw in the house. A Vjun fox followed her.''"<br />"''That would be Lady Malreaux. The fox is her familiar.|Yoda and Fidelis discussing Miss Vix|audio=VixFamiliar.flac|<ref name="YDR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>}}
A '''Force familiar''' was an animal that could share a [[Force-bond/Legends|bond]] with its owner in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. [[Vjun fox]] [[Miss Vix]] was a Force familiar for [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscountess]] [[Whirry Malreaux]] on the Force-steeped [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]<ref name="YDR" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> on which the connection with a familiar was considered an art. She stayed close to her mistress, often following her around [[Château Malreaux]], and [[Death/Legends|died]] along with the Countess following [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Mission to Vjun (Clone Wars)|occupation]] of the Château during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="YDR" />

{{Force-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The concept of a Force familiar made its first appearance in the [[2004]] [[List of novels by release date|novel]] ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' by [[Sean Stewart]].<ref name="YDR" />
